title: The pious ones of Babylonia
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rav Huna and Rav Chisda were so called, as in [Taanit 23b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.23b.9); Rav Nachman, as in [Megillah 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.28b.12-13); and Rabbi Zeira, as in [Chullin 122a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.122a.20-21).[^1]

notes.text: Taanit expressly names Huna and Chisda. Megillah places the comparison immediately after Rav Nachman’s response, and Chullin places it after Rabbi Zeira’s exchange.
